title: Word Break
hints: Plain recursion ('try every dictionary word as the next piece') re-solves the same suffix many times; on 'aaaa...ab' with words a, aa, aaa it is exponential. What is the repeated subproblem?
dp[i] = can s[:i] be segmented. dp[0] = True and dp[i] = any(dp[j] and s[j:i] in words for j < i). Put the dictionary in a set.
Only j in [i - max_word_len, i) can work, which makes it O(n * max_len) substring checks instead of O(n^2). Use the set; never scan the list.
